name: lore-cheaper
hypothesis: Lore runs are short because Lore cards are costly in wax and horn, and greedy builds the cheapest scoring card. On D9 (ccb126f) one good or coin off 9 Lore cards lifted Lore runs >= 3 from 17-22% to 29-41%. D9b (868c469) already made 4 of those 9 cuts (Star Chamber, Map Room, Skywatch Loft, Chronicle House); this overlay is the other 5: Rune Stone and Almanac House one coin off, Ferryman's Charts, Sealed Archive and Orrery one good off. Lore runs >= 3 reach 25% of towns on D9b.
